name: lucky-dungeon-tycoon-core
description: Framework-agnostic TypeScript core for the Lucky Dungeon Tycoon idle game

scripts.build:web: tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && cp web/index.html web/manifest.webmanifest web/sw.js dist-web/ && mkdir -p dist-web/web/factory dist-web/icons dist-web/vendor dist-web/models && cp web/styles.css dist-web/web/ && cp web/factory/factory.css dist-web/web/factory/ && cp web/icons/*.png dist-web/icons/ && cp web/vendor/*.js dist-web/vendor/ && cp -r web/vendor/jsm dist-web/vendor/ && cp -r web/models/* dist-web/models/ && node scripts/gen-app-config.mjs
scripts.serve:web: npm run build:web && npx -y http-server dist-web -p 8080 -c-1 -o /
scripts.sync:mobile: npm run build:web && npx cap copy
